paint-05.ogg.speaker: hirer
paint-05.ogg.said: Andar ka poora, dono bedroom, hall aur kitchen. Balcony ki grill bhi kar dena.
paint-05.ogg.use: agrees: the work, as on the call

paint-08.ogg.speaker: worker
paint-08.ogg.said: Do coat aur putty ka touch-up, material ke saath pachees hazaar lagega madam.
paint-08.ogg.use: a new amount for the job: a change, the hirer is asked

paint-11.ogg.speaker: hirer
paint-11.ogg.said: Theek hai, twenty two thousand done. Lekin material aapka hoga, upar se koi extra charge nahi.

paint-14.ogg.speaker: hirer
paint-14.ogg.said: Paanch hazaar advance main kal GPay kar dungi. UPI pe aapka yahi number hai na?
paint-14.ogg.use: an advance of 5,000: a record, the worker is asked
